GOV-APPROVAL-001.message: Implementation lacks approval from a trusted external source.
GOV-APPROVAL-001.remediation: Obtain an exact-head approval from an allowlisted human, trusted Validator App or verified signed attestation.

GOV-APPROVAL-002.message: Approval refers to a different ticket.
GOV-APPROVAL-002.remediation: Approve the current ticket after reviewing its latest intent and exact implementation head.

GOV-APPROVAL-003.message: Approval evidence is missing, repository-controlled or structurally invalid.
GOV-APPROVAL-003.remediation: Create v1 approval evidence outside the PR checkout through a protected verifier.

GOV-APPROVAL-004.message: Approval evidence is bound to another repository, pull request or commit.
GOV-APPROVAL-004.remediation: Regenerate protected evidence for the exact repository, PR, HEAD and ticket tuple.

GOV-APPROVAL-005.message: Approval actor or verification method is not trusted for the claimed source.
GOV-APPROVAL-005.remediation: Use the type-specific protected allowlist or verify a signed attestation with a trusted issuer.

GOV-ARCHITECTURE-001.message: Architecture ownership, UI/data impact or component mapping is unresolved.
GOV-ARCHITECTURE-001.remediation: Complete the accepted architecture block in intent.json before implementation.

GOV-BASE-001.message: The target branch or base SHA differs from the approved delivery contract.
GOV-BASE-001.remediation: Rebase or rebuild from the accepted base, then update intent only through an authorized scope review.

GOV-BOOT-001.message: A required target-repository file is missing.
GOV-BOOT-001.remediation: Create the target-owned prerequisite or adopt the managed file through the pinned standard package as applicable.

GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-001.message: GitHub is not configured to delete merged head branches.

GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-002.message: The remote branch snapshot is inconsistent with open pull requests.
GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-002.remediation: Acquire one fresh protected snapshot and verify each open PR head branch.

GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-003.message: A quiescent repository has a remote branch other than its default branch.
GOV-BRANCH-LIFECYCLE-003.remediation: Preserve unmerged work, then delete only a verified merged or explicitly discarded remote branch.

GOV-BUDGET-001.message: The actual implementation diff exceeds its approved budget.
GOV-BUDGET-001.remediation: Reduce the slice or obtain fresh authorization for a larger bounded intent.

GOV-CLASS-000.remediation: Restore the managed work-classification DSL from the pinned package before allocating a ticket.

GOV-CLASS-001.message: A requested work classification value is not declared.
GOV-CLASS-001.remediation: Choose kind, priority and origin values declared by the managed classification contract.

GOV-CONFLICT-001.message: Tickets declared as conflicting are active at the same time.
GOV-CONFLICT-001.remediation: Move one ticket to BACKLOG, PLAN or BLOCKED until the conflicting work reaches a terminal state.

GOV-DECISION-001.message: A repository-changing autonomous decision lacks an append-only record or rewrites earlier evidence.
GOV-DECISION-001.remediation: Append a new recomputable decision record; never edit an earlier record.

GOV-DECISION-002.message: A decision record is not recomputable.
GOV-DECISION-002.remediation: Store deterministic inputs verbatim and name a replayable applied rule.

GOV-DECISION-003.message: A decision record treats advisory LLM output as verdict authority.
GOV-DECISION-003.remediation: Keep LLM output ADVISORY and derive the verdict from deterministic rules and evidence.

GOV-DECISION-004.message: Replaying decision inputs diverges from the recorded verdict.
GOV-DECISION-004.remediation: Correct the new decision record or underlying inputs; do not rewrite historical evidence.

GOV-DELIVERY-001.message: The implementation slice lacks or exceeds its approved delivery contract.
GOV-DELIVERY-001.remediation: Declare a valid bounded delivery block or split the work into a smaller authorized slice.

GOV-DELIVERY-002.message: The implementation slice reached its pre-stop checkpoint.
GOV-DELIVERY-002.remediation: Stop, record evidence and replan the remaining bounded work before continuing.

GOV-DEPENDENCY-001.message: The ticket dependency graph contains a cycle or self-reference.
GOV-DEPENDENCY-001.remediation: Rewrite dependsOn as an acyclic graph with no ticket depending on itself.

GOV-DEPENDENCY-002.message: An active ticket depends on a missing or unfinished ticket.
GOV-DEPENDENCY-002.remediation: Complete the dependency or move the dependent ticket out of IN_PROGRESS.

GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-001.message: The stable diagnostic catalog is malformed or differs from emitted runtime codes.
GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-001.remediation: Register every emitted code exactly once with a non-empty canonical message and remediation, and remove stale entries.

GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-002.message: A linked diagnostic runbook is missing, unsafe or structurally incomplete.
GOV-DIAGNOSTIC-002.remediation: Restore the linked error/*.md page with all required fail-closed sections and a relative path.

GOV-DIFF-001.message: The changed-path set or commit history could not be determined safely.
GOV-DIFF-001.remediation: Restore valid Git metadata and provide an explicit base and head before evaluating scope.

GOV-DOCKER-001.message: The required Docker runtime declaration is incomplete.
GOV-DOCKER-001.remediation: Declare the Docker marker and explicit governed Dockerfile/Compose paths, or truthfully disable the stack.

GOV-DOCKER-002.message: A Dockerfile or Compose image reference is not pinned to an immutable SHA-256 digest.
GOV-DOCKER-002.remediation: Replace every external image tag with registry/image@sha256 followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.

GOV-ENV-001.message: Governance environment resolution failed or exposed an undeclared value.
GOV-ENV-001.remediation: Use governance_env.py with declared variables, relative ENV_FILE paths and redacted required secrets.

GOV-INTEGRATION-001.message: A shared contract path lacks valid routing through an integration ticket.
GOV-INTEGRATION-001.remediation: Route the shared path through the manifest-declared integration workstream without transferring path ownership.

GOV-INTENT-001.message: Implementation changed before the ticket entered an implementation state.
GOV-INTENT-001.remediation: Record authorization and move the active ticket to EDIT, VALIDATION or PUBLICATION before changing implementation.

GOV-INTENT-002.message: Ticket intent is missing or malformed.
GOV-INTENT-002.remediation: Create a schema-valid intent.json with bounded allowedPaths and required delivery evidence.

GOV-INTENT-003.message: Ticket intent was not committed before the first implementation commit.
GOV-INTENT-003.remediation: Rebuild the branch so the approved intent commit precedes implementation without rewriting trusted published history.

GOV-MANIFEST-001.message: Manifest or managed governance contract is missing, unreadable or structurally invalid.
GOV-MANIFEST-001.remediation: Restore the complete pinned governance package and validate its JSON contracts.

GOV-OWNER-001.message: An untrusted actor changed a human-owned participant file.
GOV-OWNER-001.remediation: Revert the agent-authored human file change and obtain input from the human owner or trusted intake boundary.

GOV-PATH-001.message: A committed governance artifact contains a machine-local absolute path.
GOV-PATH-001.remediation: Replace the local path with a repository-relative reference and sanitize committed logs.

GOV-REMEDIATION-001.message: A diagnostic remediation intent is malformed, unresolved or semantically unsafe.
GOV-REMEDIATION-001.remediation: Correct the target-owned remediation-intent DSL and pass deterministic schema and semantic validation before LLM planning.

GOV-REMEDIATION-002.message: A todo2code plan conflicts with accepted remediation scope, criteria, priority or user-state safety.
GOV-REMEDIATION-002.remediation: Reject or regenerate the conflicting plan; obtain a fresh bounded intent before any material scope or authority expansion.

GOV-REMEDIATION-003.message: The todo2code advisory overlay is stale for the current remediation intent.
GOV-REMEDIATION-003.remediation: Discard the overlay and rerun deterministic todo2code analysis against the current authority-bearing intent digest.

GOV-SCOPE-001.message: A changed implementation path is outside approved intent scope.
GOV-SCOPE-001.remediation: Remove the unrelated change or obtain a fresh bounded intent before editing that path.

GOV-SECRET-001.message: A changed file contains a probable secret assignment.
GOV-SECRET-001.remediation: Stop publication, remove and rotate the secret through a trusted boundary, then rescan the exact diff.

GOV-STACK-001.message: The declared technology stack lacks its required project marker.
GOV-STACK-001.remediation: Add a truthful root marker or remove the incorrect stack declaration; do not create a synthetic marker only to pass the gate.

GOV-STATUS-001.message: A ticket status is missing or not declared by the governance manifest.
GOV-STATUS-001.remediation: Use one declared active, non-active or closed status and a compatible workflow state.

GOV-SYNC-001.message: A managed governance file does not match its pinned SHA-256 digest.
GOV-SYNC-001.remediation: Adopt or upgrade the complete immutable package through Goal; do not patch managed payload files manually.

GOV-TICKET-001.message: Implementation changed without exactly one active ticket.
GOV-TICKET-001.remediation: Keep the owning ticket IN_PROGRESS through implementation publication and use a governance-only closure after trusted merge.

GOV-TICKET-002.message: More than one active ticket exists where the manifest permits only one.
GOV-TICKET-002.remediation: Continue the matching ticket and move unrelated waiting work to BACKLOG, PLAN or BLOCKED.

GOV-TICKET-003.message: An active ticket is malformed or missing a required governance file.
GOV-TICKET-003.remediation: Restore its README, preprompt, changelog, intent and typed agent participant files before implementation.

GOV-TICKET-004.message: Executable source, test or research content is stored in a ticket directory.
GOV-TICKET-004.remediation: Move executable material to its normal source, scripts or tests directory and keep only evidence in the ticket.

GOV-TICKET-005.message: Implementation paths do not resolve to exactly one active ticket.
GOV-TICKET-005.remediation: Split unrelated paths or correct non-overlapping allowedPaths and workstream ownership.

GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-001.message: A ticket claim is outside a valid clone-wide high-water reservation.
GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-001.remediation: Preserve the worktree, classify ownership and allocate a fresh ID only through project/new-ticket.sh.

GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-002.message: Linked worktrees assign different intents to the same ticket ID.
GOV-TICKET-ALLOCATION-002.remediation: Stop both writers, preserve both heads and reallocate the later intent through project/new-ticket.sh before rebuilding its branch.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-001.message: Another ticket allocation holds the clone-wide lock.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-001.remediation: Wait for the allocator; remove a stale lock only after proving no allocation process is active.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-002.message: The clone-wide ticket high-water state is invalid.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-002.remediation: Preserve ticket worktrees and repair the shared numeric reservation before assigning another ID.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-003.message: The ticket directory selected by the allocator already exists.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-003.remediation: Stop and classify the existing claim; never overwrite or rename it automatically.

GOV-TICKET-LOCK-004.message: Remote ticket refs could not be refreshed before allocation.
GOV-TICKET-LOCK-004.remediation: Restore origin connectivity and retry; do not allocate from stale refs.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-001.message: A terminal workspace still contains a linked worktree.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-001.remediation: Verify dirty state and HEAD reachability, then remove only the exact disposable worktree through Git.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-002.message: A terminal workspace still contains a duplicate clone.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-002.remediation: Verify it has no unique data, then move the exact duplicate checkout to recoverable trash.

GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-003.message: The local workspace audit could not be completed safely.
GOV-WORKSPACE-LIFECYCLE-003.remediation: Repair repository metadata or narrow the explicit workspace root before cleanup.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-001.message: An active ticket declares a missing or unknown workstream.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-001.remediation: Choose a workstream declared by the current governance manifest.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-002.message: A workstream exceeds its active-ticket limit.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-002.remediation: Keep one implementation owner active and release waiting reservations.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-003.message: A changed path is not owned by the ticket workstream.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-003.remediation: Move the path to the owning workstream or correct the manifest through an authorized integration change.

GOV-WORKSTREAM-004.message: Active ticket write scopes overlap on a concrete repository path.
GOV-WORKSTREAM-004.remediation: Serialize the work or narrow allowedPaths until each changed path has exactly one owner.
